_comment: Optional: run the guard hooks in EVERY session, not only when the skill is invoked. Replace <SKILL_DIR> with the installed skill folder (plugin: the path shown by `claude plugin details minimal-impact-change@harshtheskills`, under skills/minimal-impact-change; manual: the folder install.js printed). Merge the `hooks` object into ~/.claude/settings.json, and remove the `hooks:` block from SKILL.md to avoid running them twice.
